book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.en: I said to him: I know how to shoot with a bow.
He said: good, come with me to the forest.

sentences.ar: كل ليلة كنت أطلع على شجرة عالية.
sentences.en: Every night I would climb a tall tree.
And shoot an elephant for its ivory.

sentences.ar: عملت هيك شهرين وأنا مش مرتاح.
sentences.en: I did this for two months and I was not at ease.

sentences.ar: كنت بحس إني عم أعمل غلط.
sentences.en: I felt I was doing something wrong.
